d: Jailed Former Pakistan PM Imran Khan has appealed to the country’s top court for urgent medical care for himself and his wife, citing health concerns and solitary confinement. In an open letter, Khan warned he “may not return alive” and alleged that court orders for hospital treatment and family access remain unimplemented. Khan has been imprisoned since August 2023 on convictions his party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), calls politically motivated.
